# #34 — feat: add durable active session lanes

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: enhancement
Created: 2026-06-04T22:17:43Z
Updated: 2026-06-08T04:23:50Z
Closed: 2026-06-08T04:23:50Z

---

## Goal
Add a first-class durable "session lane" concept to Open Brain so agents can attach ongoing work to a stable key and reload current context without semantic search.

## Motivation
Current OB writes are mostly one-and-done entries. For active work, agents need a durable lane that survives compaction/reset and can be directly loaded by `session_key`, Discord channel/thread, agent, project, or task.

## Proposed shape
Add or extend schema to support:

- `session_key` or `lane_key` as a stable human/agent-readable identifier
- `namespace`
- `status`: `active | wrapped | archived`
- `agent`, `source`, `channel_id`, `thread_id`, `project`, `topic`
- `current_context_md` or equivalent materialized summary
- `started_at`, `updated_at`, `ended_at`

Potential table:

```sql
CREATE TABLE ob_session_lanes (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  agent TEXT,
  source TEXT,
  channel_id TEXT,
  thread_id TEXT,
  project TEXT,
  topic TEXT,
  current_context_md TEXT,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  embedding vector,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  UNIQUE(namespace, session_key)
);
```

## Acceptance criteria
- A lane can be created/upserted idempotently by namespace + session_key.
- Agents can load active lane state without semantic search.
- Existing `sessions` behavior remains backward-compatible.
- Lane records are searchable by existing OB search and filterable by namespace/status/tags.
